site.description: An independent publishing house. We publish few books, slowly: narratives, novels and short forms chosen to last.

home.heroText: An independent publishing house, we publish few books, slowly — narratives, novels, short forms. Texts we hold dear, made to last.
home.aboutP1: Founded on a simple conviction — a book is an object of slow time —, the house champions singular writing and careful craft: chosen paper, drawn typography, traditional binding.
home.aboutP2: Each project is carried out as a companionship with its author, from manuscript to bookshop. We prefer attention to quantity: a few titles a year, championed for a long time.
